title: Reasons you should stay natural: you will become psychologically addicted to PED
summary: NH argues the psychological effects of PEDs are under-discussed and potentially worse than physical side effects: supraphysiological hormones make you feel on top of the world, and coming off crashes you below baseline into depression. He likens PED dependency to hard drug addiction, criticizes TRT clinics for hooking men on high hormone levels, and says most low-T men could fix it with lifestyle changes.

claims.claim: The psychological effects of PEDs are rarely discussed because they are hidden, and users are often ashamed to testify about them.
Hormones drive how good, confident and energetic you feel; if they tank you become depressed and low energy.
Doubling or tripling your natural testosterone dose makes you feel on top of the world and more aggressive.
TRT clinics thrive by getting men hooked on high hormone levels while downplaying side effects to keep making money.
Coming off PEDs crashes hormones below normal, since the body stopped producing its own testosterone, often leading to depression and loss of motivation to lift.
PED use is drug use; he considers the mental dependency as severe as heroin even without physical cravings.
Most men who think they are low-T and get TRT could have raised testosterone naturally by changing environment, diet and starting exercise.
Physical side effects like acne, gyno, heart and liver issues are either minor or take long to build, whereas the mental effects hit immediately.
Your personality is shaped by hormones, so exogenous hormones change who you are, and the people you love must deal with those changes.
PEDs are a double whammy: dependency for keeping gains plus happiness becoming tied to the drugs, so one try can trap you for life; like hard drugs, never try them.
People who say PEDs are fine for mental health are often coping hypocrites who damaged their own mental health.
The goal of bodybuilding is to make yourself a better person; stay natural and be patient with gains.
